race.comment: Competitive race to close out the card. VANESSI (1) has placed two of three over this trip and gets some weight off with the 2kg claim. Looks close to a win following back-to-back placings and should be peaking now. OLIVONI (11) showed ability at the first campaign, easily winning a Gold Coast maiden and finishing 3L away in the Calaway Girl when last seen. Readied with a trial win and could go through the grades this time in. CIPHERTEXT (6) doesn't win out of turn but is usually thereabouts, placing in five of six starts since the maiden win. Back off a let-up but is a must for the exotics players. IDLEONBY (5) is a second-up winner in the past so can improve.
